name: red-evidence-canon-policy-foundation
title: Land RFC 8785 CANON and fail-closed red-evidence policy resolution, surfaced in doctor
description: The trusted RED-evidence subsystem spec (docs/requirements/decisions/red-evidence-subsystem-spec.md, DONE and on main) needs its foundation leaf: a single RFC 8785 JCS (JSON Canonicalization Scheme) canonicalizer that the whole subsystem digests through, plus the fail-closed policy resolver that owns the §1.2 policy table, registries, and the §1.12 hard safety floors. No existing canonicalizer can serve — core/digest.ts sorts by localeCompare and authority-signing maps null to undefined — so this must be a new leaf, proven differentially so no later reviewer re-litigates it. It terminates at a non-gating doctor health check, and deliberately commits no redEvidence block to lattice.config.json because pinnedPath is host-specific and required-with-no-default.
